CHAPTER I.
The letter

“Café, 文学, and a rabbit 🐇,” she said. Nothing was lost—not even punctuation.

The snow arrived before your letter. I left the lamp beside the window and waited for the long winter evening to end, watching each quiet shadow travel across the floor.

    Little Lamb, who made thee?
    Dost thou know who made thee?

    Gave thee life, and bid thee feed
    By the stream and o'er the mead;

CHAPTER II.
A reply

Tomorrow I will write again.

A table keeps its spaces:
  north    south
  east     west
